content: स्थावर {%a.%} [स्था-वरच्] .²1 Fixed to one spot, stable, stationary, immoveable, inanimate (<ab>opp.</ab> जङ्गम); शरीरिणां स्थावरजङ्गमानां सुखाय तज्जन्मदिनं बभूव <ls>Ku. 1. 23</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">6. 67</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 6.">73</ls>. .²2 Inert, inactive, slow. .²3 Regular, established. .{@-रः@} A mountain; स्थावराणां हिमालयः <ls>Bg. 10. 25</ls>. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Any stationary or inanimate object (such as clay, stones, trees <ab>&c.</ab> which formed the seventh creation of Brahman; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 1. 41</ls>); मान्यः स मे स्थावरजङ्गमानां सर्गस्थितिप्रत्यवहारहेतुः <ls>R. 2. 44</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 58</ls>. .²2 A bow-string. .²3 Immoveable property, real estate. .²4 A heir-loom. .²5 A large body; (<ab>fig.</ab>) a gross or material body (स्थूलशरीर); गमनं निरपेक्षश्च पश्चादनवलोकयन् . ऋजुः प्रणिहितो गच्छंस्त्रसस्थावरवर्जकः <ls>Mb. 12. 9. 19</ls>.
